title: BRAG: Bayesian Retrieval Augmented Generation
abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ranks memory chunks by semantic similarity to the query. Many methods improve on this by learning from feedback on what was retrieved, but each is a separate heuristic, with no account of when it is the right choice. We introduce BRAG, a generative model of retrieval with use. Each chunk generates the queries it answers from a mixture of von Mises-Fisher components anchored at its original embedding, and each chunk has a latent utility that drifts over time. The model gives the optimal inference, a closed-form filter that stores a few keys and two scalars per chunk and updates them online from the labels of a curator, and it frames retrieval as a control problem. It also shows when existing methods are optimal. Query averaging, Rocchio-style feedback and frequency reranking are special cases with fixed parameters, NUDGE is the case of one key per chunk with no dynamics, and LADER the limit of one key per past query. On two public long-term memory benchmarks, BRAG matches these methods on queries asked before, as expected, because when nothing changes over time the assumptions behind these special cases hold. On harder problems, where a new chunk makes an old one obsolete, BRAG outscores them. They all stay at plain-search level (Recall@5 0.67-0.71), while BRAG retrieves the new chunk 0.80-0.86 of the time. We also ran BRAG on three of NUDGE's seven text benchmarks, and it matches or beats NUDGE on all three. On nine months of a personal agent's memory (20,640 chunks), BRAG raises Recall@5 on held-out queries from 0.75 to 0.98 and Recall@1 from 0.44 to 0.97, with little change on chunks never queried.
abstract_zh: 传统检索增强生成（RAG）按查询与记忆片段的语义相似度排序，而利用检索反馈的现有方法多为独立的启发式策略，缺乏对各自适用条件的解释。BRAG 为检索建立了一个随使用更新的贝叶斯生成模型：每个片段能回答的查询由以其原始嵌入为锚点的 von Mises–Fisher 混合分布生成，片段的潜在效用则随时间漂移。该模型将检索表述为控制问题，并导出闭式滤波器：每个片段只需保存少量检索键和两个标量，即可根据人工标注在线更新。BRAG 还揭示了查询平均、Rocchio 式反馈、频次重排序、NUDGE 和 LADER 各自对应的特例或极限情形。在两个公开长期记忆基准上，BRAG 对曾出现的查询与现有方法表现相当；当新片段取代旧片段时，BRAG 对新片段的 Recall@5 达到 0.80–0.86，而对比方法仍处于纯相似度检索水平（0.67–0.71）。在 NUDGE 的七个文本基准中选测的三个上，BRAG 均持平或更优。在覆盖九个月、含 20,640 个片段的个人智能体记忆中，BRAG 将留出查询的 Recall@5 从 0.75 提升至 0.98，Recall@1 从 0.44 提升至 0.97，对从未被查询过的片段影响很小。
key_points_zh: 联合建模片段能回答哪些查询，以及片段的效用如何随时间变化。
闭式滤波器利用人工标注在线更新，每个片段仅保存少量检索键和两个标量。
查询平均、Rocchio 式反馈和频次重排序是固定参数下的特例；NUDGE 对应单键且无时间演化的情形，LADER 对应为每条历史查询保留一个键的极限。
当新片段使旧片段过时时，BRAG 对新片段的 Recall@5 为 0.80–0.86，对比方法为 0.67–0.71。
在含 20,640 个片段的个人智能体记忆中，留出查询的 Recall@1 从 0.44 提升至 0.97，Recall@5 从 0.75 提升至 0.98。

agent-memory.reason: BRAG 将检索反馈持久写入文本代理的外部记忆索引，更新检索键和随时间衰减的效用估计，从而改变后续召回。两个长期记忆基准的对照与消融显示，效用动态有助于召回取代旧信息的新片段；实验也量化了从未被查询的片段所受的检索损失。
